description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of issue type scheme items.

Only issue type scheme items used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: The list of issue type scheme IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `issueTypeSchemeId=10000&issueTypeSchemeId=10001`.
parameters.name: issueTypeSchemeId

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.
